Create DNA Count Matrix

create_dna_df.Rd

Convert a long-format DNA count data frame into a wide-format matrix suitable for MPRA analysis.

create_dna_df(df, id_column_name = "variant_id", allele_column_name = NULL)

Arguments

df

A data frame containing DNA counts in long format.

id_column_name

Column name for variant identifiers.

allele_column_name

Column name for allele values. If NULL, uses "allele" when present.

Value

A wide-format data frame with DNA counts per allele.

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  variant_id = c("var1", "var2", "var1", "var2"),
  allele = c("ref", "ref", "alt", "alt"),
  DNA_A = c(100, 200, 150, 250)
)
create_dna_df(df)
#>      bc1_ref bc1_alt
#> var1     100     150
#> var2     200     250
